results.text: Low-Dose Oral Minoxidil and Associated Adverse Events: Analyses of the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) With a Focus on Pericardial Effusions. Low-dose oral minoxidil (LDOM) is used to treat hair loss, but the literature on its safety profile is relatively sparse. Using the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) database, we determined signals for adverse events (AEs) with LDOM use.
